title: Trail and Escarpment
author: R. M. Reyes
blurb: Isandro Ishikawa, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
